insights.summary: Several reports describe missing, delayed, timed-out, or stale records across CRM, calendar, and HRIS synchronization.
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: investigate connector freshness and failure observability, and consider surfacing record-level sync status and retry paths.

insights.summary: Mobile interaction and assistive-technology barriers recur, including obscured/clipped controls and unannounced fields or errors.
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: audit key mobile flows across keyboard layouts, larger text, and screen readers; add accessibility regression tests.

insights.summary: Reporting feedback repeatedly points to difficulty filtering, exporting, excluding data, or interpreting chart definitions.
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: evaluate clearer chart metadata and consistent filter/export behavior, including test-ticket exclusion.

insights.summary: Users describe duplicate or excessive routine notifications, including invitation, reassignment, and invoice emails.
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: investigate event deduplication and user controls for routine notification channels and frequency.

insights.summary: New admins report unclear prerequisites and incomplete first-run guidance around settings, invitations, and permissions.
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: test a sequenced setup checklist that makes required settings and permissions explicit before invitations.
